currentFocus: S319 repaired a live production outage: a KV write-quota exhaustion caused by the /v/rum beacon writing a rate-limit counter on every request took down telemetry ingestion AND sign-in via unhandled Worker exceptions. It also made the release candidate reproducible, gave the production hold a blast radius across both authority and evidence, and put The Desk on a schedule and on the homepage.
